question.text: The Sponsor/Manager continuing interest in a Category III AIF must be NOT LESS THAN:

answer.text: 2.5% of corpus OR Rs. 5 crore, whichever is lower
5% of corpus OR Rs. 10 crore, whichever is lower

explanation.text: The Logic: The Sponsor/Manager of a Category III AIF must maintain a continuing interest of not less than 5% of the corpus or Rs. 10 crore, whichever is lower. The Trap: 2.5% of corpus or Rs. 5 crore, 10% of corpus and Rs. 25 crore absolute are not the prescribed Cat III continuing-interest threshold. Note: The "whichever is lower" formulation means the cap is the smaller of 5% of corpus and Rs. 10 crore in absolute terms.
